# Vancouver Island School of Art

> A Victoria-based art education institution offering in-person and online courses in painting, drawing, and mixed media for students of all skill levels.

Vancouver Island School of Art provides comprehensive art instruction through workshops and courses taught by experienced instructors. The school serves the Victoria, BC community with both beginner-friendly introductions and advanced techniques across painting, drawing, and design disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Art education
- Painting courses
- Drawing workshops
- Landscape painting
- Colour theory
- Watercolour techniques
- Gouache painting
- Design practice
- Geometric abstraction
- Visual arts instruction
- Victoria, BC
- In-person and online learning
- Beginner-friendly classes
- Master artists
- Skill development

## Core Programs & Courses

- [Courses & Workshops](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/courses-workshops): Main catalog of art courses and workshops in painting, drawing, and mixed media
- [Painting: Introduction II](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/painting-introduction-ii): Intermediate painting course exploring subject matter, style, and technique with historical models
- [Landscape Painting Now II](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/landscape-painting-now-ii): Intermediate landscape painting course exploring contemporary artists and constructed realities
- [Painting Inspired by Landscape](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/painting-inspired-by-landscape): Landscape painting course developing skills through natural world inspiration and colour exploration
- [Colour in Painting](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/colour-in-painting): Painting course exploring colour theory from Renaissance through contemporary art movements
- [Painting: Light and Shadow](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/painting-light-and-shadow): Painting course focused on tonal ranges and dramatic light effects using glazing techniques
- [Watercolours Inspired by Cezanne](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/watercolours-inspired-by-cezanne): Online watercolour landscape course inspired by Cezanne's artistic approach and techniques
- [Painting the Everyday with Gouache](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/painting-the-everyday-with-gouache): Beginner-friendly gouache painting course inspired by artist Maira Kalman using everyday subjects
- [Drawing Nature](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/drawing-nature): Drawing workshop focusing on natural subjects including plants, animals, and landscape forms
- [Design Practice: Geometric Abstraction](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/design-practice-geometric-abstraction): Workshop on geometric abstraction design using cut paper and watercolour painting techniques
- [Photo Walk: Downtown Victoria](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/service-page/photo-walk-downtown-victoria): Photo walk workshop in Downtown Victoria with instructor Thomas Guerrero on photography themes

## About & Information

- [Home](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com): Homepage for Vancouver Island School of Art offering in-person and online courses in Victoria, BC
- [About Us](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/about): About page describing Vancouver Island School of Art's programs and community learning mission
- [Contact](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/contact): Contact information, location on Johnson St, hours, and payment options for Vancouver Island School of Art

## Support & Community

- [Donate](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/donate): Donation page for one-time or monthly contributions via PayPal and VISA
- [Sponsors](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/sponsors): Local Victoria business sponsors supporting the art school including ArtSEE Eyewear and Head over Heels
- [Press](https://www.vancouverislandschoolart.com/press): Press coverage and newsletter archives featuring media mentions from CHEK TV, CBC, and CTV
